statements.quote: On January 10, 2024, the Company announced it had increased the size of its contract for up to an aggregate of 2,048 GPUs worth more than $50 million of annualized revenues to the Company.
statements.notes: Annualized contract value for the WhiteFiber AI cloud services contract, not reported revenue for a fiscal year. 'More than $50 million' recorded as a lower bound of 50000000. No fiscal year is named.

statements.quote: The initial order of 300 GPUs is expected to generate approximately $4.6 million in revenue to Bit Digital over the five-year term, or approximately $0.9 million per year.
statements.notes: Annual figure from the HPC GPU cloud services contract with Boosteroid. Boosteroid is a cloud gaming customer, not an AI customer, so this is HPC/data-center revenue rather than strictly AI revenue. The $4.6 million five-year total is also stated.

statements.quote: It represents an aggregate revenue opportunity of approximately $20.2 million.
statements.notes: Aggregate revenue opportunity over a 25-month H200 GPU services contract with an AI Compute Fund. It is a multi-year contract value, not revenue for one fiscal year, and it is terminable on notice.

statements.quote: Concurrently, we placed a purchase order for 130 H200 servers for approximately $30 million.
statements.notes: A purchase commitment for AI GPU servers placed on December 30, 2024; deployment began in February 2025. It is recorded as outlook because the sentence states an order, not a completed expenditure.

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or explicitly attributes operating expenses to AI. The R&D discussion in p05 concerns cloud services capabilities without stating AI spend.
